There are potentially quite a few tables to jump/query through to be able to tell if the tests are still running. Also, it's possible that a test takes a very long time and hits a task timeout.

I think it would be better to show just a loading icon to the left/right of the `B: XX N: XX` to show that there is something running in the push at the moment. This one query could then be shown on all tests within that push.

That said, I'm not entirely sure how/where it may be best to display the loading icon though. Another option is to add an icon/something next to the revision to show that tests are still running.

We should only allow 1 retrigger at a time. The reason we currently have it as 1 retrigger on the compare view side is that devs tend to go overboard with the number of retriggers which causes issues for CI capacity.
